method: Windows computer-use screenshots and accessibility tree; screenshots are retained in the audit conversation. No screenshot pixel-diff or DPI measurement is claimed.
userOverride: Editor header must be bounded and centered rather than full width.
observed: Browse grid populated from the 354-photo local folder.
Opening the first RAW entered Preview with its selected thumbnail and saved edited pixels.
Editor header was centered at approximately x=594..1314 in the 1908-wide capture, with back, filename/status, histogram, undo, compare, more actions and export.
Histogram was blank during RAW decode, then populated after the GPU canvas appeared.
Light inspector showed Profile, Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites and Blacks; Reset was visible.
Seven labeled dock tools were visible: Light, Color, Effects, Detail, Curve, Mask and Crop.
Editor filmstrip was a bounded floating panel showing five thumbnails and the current selection.
Back returned to Preview; Info opened as a right pane with rating, clear, three flag choices, camera/file metadata and metadata-edit entry point.
Opening Info reduced the photo viewport and kept the selected photo.
Expanding Preview navigation changed the rail to filename/metadata rows while preserving the selected photo and the open Info pane. The toggle remained in the pane header.
Color Basic displayed white-balance preset/picker, temperature, tint, vibrance and saturation in the floating inspector.
HSL displayed the color-band sliders; wheel scrolling advanced from Red/Orange/Yellow to Green/Aqua/Blue/Purple/Magenta while keeping the Color tabs visible.
Effects Basic displayed clarity, texture, dehaze, vignette/feather and grain amount/size/roughness.
Detail displayed sharpening, noise reduction and defringe controls; vertical scrolling exposed the lower demosaic description and Remove Chromatic Aberration switch.
Curve displayed its live histogram backdrop, Luma/R/G/B tabs, editable plot and four parametric sliders.
Mask displayed the empty state and Add linear mask/Add radial mask actions.
Crop displayed its overlay, straighten control, Reset and Done. Horizontal scrolling moved the aspect chips; the accessibility tree exposed all nine ratios and named keyboard-operable crop handles.
More editing actions exposed Lens corrections, Film looks, Heal / Clone, Presets, Geometry, Brightness and Scopes. Film looks opened with category chips and the film catalog. No film was applied.
limitations: This records panel appearance and navigation at one window size. It does not qualify every editing action, populated-mask state, subtab, responsive breakpoint or keyboard path.
No ratings, flags or adjustments were changed during this inspection.
RAW decode visibly required a wait; no controlled timing was captured.
Current DPI was not measured; this is not the required 100/150/200 percent matrix.
Accessibility names were inspected but Narrator and full keyboard traversal were not qualified.
Color parity, live-cloud behavior and reference-hardware performance remain separate unmet gates.
